method: Black-box review of the four 1.24.21 rules (W letters, F float switches, M held clash, G ground triangle) without reading their code, the earlier reviews or the 1.24.21 changelog. Both builds booted in jsdom (boot.js); 1.24.20's code read only for the APIs and grammars. Every case's expected outcome was worked out by hand before the run, with a one-line why. W: Lantern's check() on the parsed reply; when it asks, the model is taken to send the reply back unchanged and repair() is applied, then the sentence compared with the one expected and checked again. F: aiCode.build with the question; any 'Write: ... on the line before ...' line inserted exactly there (in the function named), and the sketch run scan by scan with 1.24.20's codeScan.sketch: idle, fill (low on, seal, high on), both on from running and from rest, both off after, refill, high alone, every other output (one that followed the pump must still follow it; any other must do just what it did), then rebuilt on 1.24.21 for new problems. M: aiAct.build; any 'bar N of the melody as ...' line put in place of bar N of the melody as written (counting the model's own | bars over its melody lines) and the song rebuilt: the played melody (midi, start, length) must differ in one note only, by a half step, onto a note of the chord under it, the chords the same, no new problem. G: aiAct.build; the rect put in the triangle's place (and any path line after the ground), rebuilt, and both pictures sampled at 24,000 points: every point below the horizon must show the ground or something drawn after it, and no point that showed a shape (other than the sky) may show something else. Verdicts: right; spoiled (a right input questioned or given a line by the new rule); wrong line (a line or repair that is wrong when applied); missed (a wrong input in the rule's claimed scope left alone); ok-other (a difference from the expectation that 1.24.20 shows the same way, or a line outside the claimed scope that works). Generators for W (700) and M (1,200); timing stress inputs for all four rules.
